input.quote: Customer agrees to provide all reasonable and necessary access, support and cooperation for Kubient to provide the Services in a timely and effective manner.
input.rationale: Searches for "audit", "inspect", "records" and "verif" return no hits, and a full read of the Agreement (single section, paras p0000–p0074, including the Fees and Payment provision at p0023 and the Use of Service compliance covenants at p0025) shows no audit, inspection or usage-verification right exercisable against us. The only access language (p0001) is operational cooperation so Kubient can deliver the Services, not a right to audit our usage, books or systems, and there is no remote or direct system-access right. Because the Agreement imposes no audit obligation on us at all, the position is better than the playbook's preferred position (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor's cost, no system access), so there is nothing to limit and no redline is warranted. Worth noting for the negotiation record: the revenue-share model in p0023 measures Impressions "as measured by Kubient" (p0009), so we may separately wish to seek audit rights against the Vendor's reporting — that is a customer-favourable addition outside the scope of this rule.
